title: Such puffed potato puffs that you can also eat with chutney or ketchup - Aloo Puri
description: Ingredients for this recipe - Alu ki puri Potato (medium size) - 2, boiled Ginger - 1 Inch Garlic - 4 to 4 buds Green chili - 1, big chopped Cumin - 1/2 teaspoon Salt - 1 teaspoon Flacks of dry red chili - 1/4 teaspoon Coriander leaves - 1 teaspoon Flour - 1 cup   Edible oil - 1 tsp + according to frying , Aloo ki puri Potato (Medium Size) - 2, Boiled Ginger - 1 Inch Garlic - 7 to 8 Cloves Green Chilli - 1, Chopped Cumin seeds - ½ tsp Salt - 1 tsp Chilli Flakes - 4 TSP Coriander Leaves - 1 Table Spoon Wheat Flour - 1 Cup Edible Oil - 1 Tsp + to Deep Fry

asr.full_text: Puri Roti You can see how fluffy the puri is You will also like it if you like to eat paratha of potatoes You can have this with dal, curd, achaar and tomato ketchup Come, lets make aloo puri We have 2 potato pieces will be soft and won't break Come, let's start making the puri we have taken 2 boiled potatoes washed them well and boiled them till 3 whistles now we will cut it We have chopped it well Now, we will cut it big Cut them big Now we have peeled and cut the potatoes Now, lets size them up This how you can make big sizes We have sliced the potatoes now lets prepare the masala to grind the masalas, we am using a small blender jar Firstly, we add ginger its a small piece of gingerot, which we have cut fine We need to grind it well, so we have cut it very fine And add 7-8 cloves of Garlic we will add this in the mix Also add, Green Chillies, broken into two parts Add green chillies In the same way add of cumin seeds Add the remaining potato pieces Add some crushed ginger- garlic- chili Add chopped vegetables Mix this with the flour Add the rest of the potatoes If you had a problem grinding, you can add some water I have used about 1 spoon of water Our potatoes are ready Lets take it out into a bowl Lets start the next process We will add about 1 spoon of salt You can add as much and as little salt as you want with this In the same pan add 1tsp salt Salt can be added as per your taste Then add quarter tsp chilly flakes We am not adding chilly flakes because we had grinded 1 red chilli If you like more spicy add more We will add chilly flakes in pizza For this we add green chillies If you do not have chilled chili flakes, you can also use red chillis Now we'll add 1 tablespoon coriander We've chosen the green coriander leaves not the stalks because leaves look great with this That's why I haven't taken the stalks Let me show you so the leaves look good this gives a nice touch we have grated this potato it has to be smooth while the puris must be well-cooked we will add flour slowly I'll mix it well you can see that it's looking good We will first add 1 cup of flour Its looking very nice We will mix the flour little by little We have taken 1 cup of flour We will use the same type of flour the same type to use the same dough for making poori flour Now we have just put one cup of wheat flour into the mill We have put one cup of wheat flour If we have added more water while grinding sure to knead it to a certain level It should stick well to the ball Take 1 tsp of oil on the dough and mix the dough well the dough should be smooth as you can see the dough is nicely wrapped we will covered the dough on a lid and keep for 10 mins after 10 mins Make a small hole on the dough and place the dough into it. Let us open the dough. Grease the bowl with oil and fry it well And again we will knead See that dough is very smooth Now we will cut very small sized pieces of dough And ready according to size of your puri And here I have also made the small puri size of a lemon Break the lemon sized small balls Take the oil in a pan Turn on the gas Take the oil we are using to prepare the puri Now give a little dough on the puff And roll it well Now mix everything well The size of the Puri you can make it larger or smaller as your choice You can see I have made the puri according to this size You can see the perfect size of the puri Coriander powder, Red red chilli too this Puri looks nice children would also like to eat it as soon as the oil heats up it will be fried now oil is heating up lets Add the Puris keep adding hot oil over the poori can be a little hot. Keep the poori on the flame. Keep the flame on very high and then flip it on the other side too. You can see the poori has been cooked well. Turn over the other side slowly. Press it lightly. If you don't want to crack any pointy part on the poori, It is almost cooked till the top. now we will apply little oil in the sides. Add the fried Puri on the heat. Add little oil on the side to make them crispy. Puri is now soft and crispy. It look nicely crispy, after we take them out from the oil. And then the Puri should turn out crispy See from here you can see that it has turned out very crispy Now we will take out the Puri Now you can see that how Puri has turn out very quick So for breakfast you can easily make this Puri Please tell me in the comment box For such awesome recipes, please subscribe to PapaMummyKitchen See you in another video, till then, goodbye and take care
